sanskrit_verse:
पालनीयाः समर्थैस्तु यः समर्थो विसंवदेत् ।
सर्वस्वहरणं दण्डस्तस्य निर्वासनं पुरात् ॥
transliteration: pālanīyāḥ samarthais tu yaḥ samartho visaṃvadet | sarvasvaharaṇaṃ daṇḍas tasya nirvāsanaṃ purāt ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who, being capable, fails in protecting those under protection shall forfeit all possessions and be expelled from the city.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inseparable from capacity to protect
Causation arises through conscious omission by a competent agent
Capacity-based responsibility demands execution of protective duty
Restoration logic requires removal of unqualified authority
Consciousness alignment necessitates structural correction over punitive suffering
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.has_capacity AND agent.is_designated_protector AND agent.fails_to_act THEN revoke_authority(agent)
IF agent.is_in_capable_category AND harm_occurs THEN initiate_completion_process(agent)
IF violation.is_structural THEN enforce_removal_from_jurisdiction UNTIL restoration_is_verified
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a custodian or protector with proven capacity defaults in their sworn duty, punitive measures are irrelevant; instead, full restitution must occur through asset forfeiture and removal from jurisdiction until verifiable realignment with dharma is demonstrated.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that capability entails obligation. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that failure to act by a capable protector initiates sequential breakdown of societal integrity. Responsibility is proportional to capacity. The corrective mechanism aligns not through pain but through structural recalibration ensuring future alignment with truth-consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Sarvadharmatmak Nyaya process for competency-realization audit
Enforce Nirvāsa protocol: temporary exclusion from authority domain
Execute Samputa Prakriya: containment and guided reintegration after completion
Implement Samarthi Samanvaya Vidhi: mandatory restoration of capacity before reappointment
Undertake Dharohara Punarsthapana: return seized assets only upon verified reconstruction of protective integrity
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from capacity-bound duty, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Reality remains non-punitive. Protection is a sacred trust revoked by omission. All else follows restoration.
